instruction.name: vmsub.w
instruction.description: Multiply 32-bit elements in `b` and `c`, subtract the low 32 bits of the product from elements in `a`, save the result in `dst`.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr3, $r4
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; vreplgr2vr.w $vr3, $r4' --asm 'vmsub.w $vr0, $vr1, $vr2'
